metas.name: Me Before You
metas.description: Lou Clark, a directionless 26-year-old from the English countryside, takes a job at the local castle as a caregiver and companion to a wealthy young banker, Will Traynor. Wheelchair-bound from an accident two years prior, the once adventurous Will has all but given up — that is until Lou determines to show him that life is worth living.

metas.name: Final Destination: Bloodlines
metas.description: Plagued by a violent recurring nightmare, college student Stefanie heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

metas.name: Never Surrender
metas.description: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

metas.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

metas.name: Kijsada Paradise
metas.description: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

metas.name: Bunny!
metas.description: A host of a relationship advice television programme starts to see cracks in her own marriage after the appearance of a mysterious guest.

metas.name: In the Heart of the Sea
metas.description: In the winter of 1820, the New England whaling ship Essex is assaulted by something no one could believe—a whale of mammoth size and will, and an almost human sense of vengeance.

metas.name: Mai
metas.description: When a struggling single mother falls for a wealthy heartbreaker, their risky romance could just turn their lives around — or tear their worlds apart.
